t: Dr. Wayne Dyer: There's a Spiritual Solution to Every Problem
d: Wayne Dyer reveals how elevating your spiritual energy transforms your entire life.

t: Dr. Wayne Dyer: I Can Do It
d: Wayne Dyer says effort is not what holds you back, your concept of yourself is and that can be reprogrammed.
Wayne Dyer shares life-changing lessons on love, purpose, and transcending the ego to find true freedom.

t: Dr. Wayne Dyer: Change Your Thoughts, Change Your Life
d: Wayne Dyer reveals how ancient Taoist wisdom can radically shift your thoughts, and your entire life.
Wayne Dyer shares a step-by-step method to silence excuses and unlock your best life.

t: Dr. Wayne Dyer: How to Get What You Really, Really, Really, Really Want
d: Wayne Dyer reveals how to harness the power of thought and higher awareness to attract what you truly desire.
Wayne Dyer teaches how to align with your divine nature and manifest an extraordinary, wishes-fulfilled life.

t: Dr. Wayne Dyer: The Power of Intention
d: Wayne Dyer reveals intention as a universal force to align with, transforming how you live.
